notes.title: Get Ready to Hit the Track in Crazy Chicken Kart 4!
notes.notes:
[h1]Crazy Chicken Kart 4![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654263/70fb75ae0bf14fa361b5efa43c65a51bb8c3f552.jpg[/img]

The wait is almost over! [b]Crazy Chicken Kart 4[/b] isn’t just a return to the racetrack; it’s a whole new adventure, built from scratch with new visuals, gameplay mechanics, and exciting features! With challenging tracks, colourful characters, and plenty of surprises, this isn’t a remake of an old classic—it’s a brand-new experience for Moorhuhn fans and kart racing enthusiasts alike.

[b]Crazy Chicken Kart 4[/b] invites players into the lively world of the classic Moorhuhn characters (and new ones, too!). This time, they’re taking a break from their usual adventures to hit the racetrack. Get behind the wheel as one of your favourite characters and compete against other players or AI in a fast-paced, feather-flying karting competition. With multiple game modes, custom karts, and power-ups, [b]Crazy Chicken Kart 4[/b] promises fun for racers of all skill levels.

[h2]What Will the Gameplay Look Like?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43914311/161225d751793fe248b3d8c1840dc4e36d56133e.jpg[/img]

In [b]Crazy Chicken Kart 4[/b], players race through creatively designed tracks, each packed with unique challenges, hidden shortcuts, and lively details. Customise your kart’s wheels, body, and engine to achieve the best stats, and make the most of well-timed items and clever manoeuvres. With modes for solo racers and multiplayer madness, [b]Crazy Chicken Kart 4[/b] promises seamless, fast-paced action for everyone. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43914311/d74029b03ce26cd637c583277ee4c7a9d26cbb03.jpg[/img]

From jungle trails to icy slopes and Sven Bømwøllen’s Meadow, each track has been crafted to bring out the best of modern karting action. With entirely new gameplay and visuals, [b]Crazy Chicken Kart 4[/b] is more than just a nostalgic nod—it's a whole new racing adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43914311/7334300342523fdd8d18c6350e17bc6760cf16a5.jpg[/img]
[i]Please remember: The game is still in development and the features are not final. There might be changes along the way.[/i]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cross-Platform Multiplayer: Race online with up to 8 players, challenging friends or rivals.
[*] Local Split-Screen: Enjoy up to 4-player split-screen fun with family and friends.
[*] Single Player & Grand Prix Modes: Test your skills solo or compete in Grand Prix mode against challenging AI.
[*] 12 tricky Tracks: Navigate twists and turns across iconic Crazy Chicken locations, filled with fun references.
[*] 11 funny new items: Use classics like the 16t weight and discover new ones to gain an edge.
[*] 8 playable Characters: Choose from familiar faces plus Midnight, the friendly bat!
[/list]
[b]Ready to race? Don't chicken out—give that wishlist button a peck![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012980

notes.title: Difficulty Update
notes.notes:
Hello Crackshots!

With this update we followed a suggestion from the community to make unlocking the levels easier. This should now be possible for all players with a little practice.

This does not change the overall game difficulty or the Highscore list.

[h2]Changelist[/h2]

[b]Difficulty[/b]
- To unlock the Castle and Village levels you now need 500 points
- We have implemented a light aim assist for controllers - it should now be easier to aim with those (Aiming with the mouse remains unchanged) 

[b]UI[/b]
- Awarded points in the Multiplayer and Hot-Seat modes are now shown in the players' color
- Small animations in the main menu

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Duplicated entries could occur in the highscore list - this should now be fixed
- Small fixes

Your Korion-Team
